draft.subject: Perception and Edge AI robotics role, for the recruitment team
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas, and I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I reached out to Michael Young about the Robotics Software Engineer role for perception and edge AI, and his automatic reply pointed me to your team to pass a message along. I have also applied to the role directly.

The role lines up closely with what I do. I build computer vision and object tracking software and deploy it onto NVIDIA Jetson and embedded controllers, tuned to run fast enough for a robot to act in real time. My capstone took a vision guided robotic arm from perception through to the physical grasp, and I have also built perception stacks for autonomous driving in simulation and a tracking turret running on Jetson.

Could you pass this along to whoever on the recruitment team is handling the search, or point me to the right person to speak with?
draft.hook_used: Michael Young out-of-office reply directed me to this team
